summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release titled "Monthly New Residential Construction, August 2022" (released September 20, 2022). For the task, it supplies the Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for August 2022: Total Housing Starts at 1,575,000, Single-family Starts at 935,000, and Starts in Buildings with Five or More Units at 621,000. As a preliminary report, these values serve as the initial source for August 2022 and may be superseded by more recent reports in the collection according to the task's conflict resolution rule.
